    Create a frequency plot

    makeFrequencyPlot.Rd

    This function takes a scCNVisObject and outputs a ggplot2 object

    makeFrequencyPlot(
  obj,
  gr = NULL,
  group = "Sample",
  gain.color = "cornflowerblue",
  loss.color = "deeppink",
  secondary.group = NULL,
  data.func = NULL,
  remove.chr.prefix = TRUE,
  verbose = F
)

    Arguments

    obj

    A scCNVisObject made using createPlotObject()

    gr

    A GenomicRanges:GRanges object of the regions to graph. If NULL, all regions will be plotted. Default = NULL

    group

    Metadata column. Average signal will be calculated per group and then called as loss/neutral/gain. Default = "Sample"

    gain.color

    Color to represent gain frequency. Default = 'cornflowerblue'

    loss.color

    Color to represent loss frequency. Default = 'deeppink'

    secondary.group

    Secondary group for plot groupings. Must use a column introduced by data.fun. See FrequencyPlot example on Github for details. Default = NULL

    data.func

    A function for defining thresholds of loss(0)/neutral(1)/gain(2) and otherwise manipulating plot data. If not provided, mean +/- sd will be used for thresholding. See FrequencyPlot example on Github for examples. Default = NULL

    remove.chr.prefix

    Remove 'chr' prefix of chromosome names. Default = TRUE

    verbose

    Verbose logging. Default = FALSE

    Value

    Returns a list containing a "Plot" (ComplexHeatmap) and "PlotData" (matrix)
